name: FreshTable
description: Pantry, shopping list, meal plan and the recipes behind them.
author: Cypher Sisters

tools.add_pantry: Add a food item to the pantry, or add to its count if it is already there.
tools.list_pantry: List what is in the pantry. Filter by a category, or use "low" for items running low.
tools.add_shopping: Put an item on the shopping list.
tools.list_shopping: List what is still on the shopping list.
tools.check_off_shopping: Tick an item off the shopping list (bought).
tools.remove_shopping: Take an item off the shopping list.
tools.list_meal_plan: List the meals planned for the week.
tools.add_meal: Plan a meal for a day of the week.
tools.add_recipe: Save a recipe: its name, ingredients and instructions.
tools.list_recipes: List the saved recipes with their ingredients.
tools.import_recipes: Read recipes from a file the owner sent (text or a photo of a recipe) and save them. A text file comes as file_name, mime and text; any other file as file_name, mime and content_b64.

add_shopping: put milk on the shopping list
list_shopping: what is on the shopping list
add_pantry: add a bag of rice to the pantry
list_pantry: what is running low in the pantry
check_off_shopping: I bought the eggs, tick them off
remove_shopping: take the bread off the shopping list
list_meal_plan: what dinners are planned this week
add_meal: plan chicken fajitas for Tuesday dinner
add_recipe: save my pancake recipe: flour, milk, eggs; whisk and fry
import_recipes: import the recipes in my file pancakes.txt: Pancakes. Flour, milk, eggs. Whisk and fry.

consent: FreshTable keeps your pantry, lists and recipes in its own data folder on this computer. Meal ideas and photo reading use the brain on this computer. It does not use the internet.
